{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out refunded orders — they should not count toward conversion rate
sales_df_completed = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute conversion rate per customer_segment
conversion_rates = sales_df_completed.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment = conversion_rates.idxmax()
highest_rate = conversion_rates.max()

print(f"Conversion rates by segment:\n{conversion_rates}")
print(f"Highest conversion rate: {highest_segment} with {highest_rate:.4f}")"}
